steps.content:
You should buy from **Ottervale Audio - Option B: https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/jevafc/b**

The two listings are identical on everything that matters except one thing:

| | **A - Brackmoor Sound** | **B - Ottervale Audio** |
|---|---|---|
| **Product** | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones | Same |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | Free standard, 3-5 business days | Free standard, 3-5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30-day, buyer pays return shipping | 30-day, buyer pays return shipping |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty **+ Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.** |

**Why B is the better choice:**

Both sellers offer the same price, stock, shipping, and return policy, so there is no downside to picking B.

But B explicitly states **"Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."**

A does not. That matters for headphones because:

1.  **Authenticity:** Authorized dealer status is your best guarantee you're getting a genuine Quellwyn product, not grey-market or counterfeit.
2.  **Warranty will actually be honored:** Many brands will not honor a manufacturer warranty if you buy from an unauthorized seller — even if the seller offers their own "1-year limited warranty." With Ottervale, Quellwyn themselves will support it.

Unless you have a specific reason to prefer Brackmoor Sound, Ottervale Audio gives you the same deal with less risk.
